A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same URSA research despite the changed title and front matter. All 39 pages, including Appendices A–H, provide matching text, equations, tables, figures, and case studies sufficient for reliable comparison.

before.justification: v5 reports original URSA benchmark results, Best-of-N evaluations, PS-GRPO experiments, and ablations in Sections 5–6 and the appendices.

after.justification: v6 reports the same original empirical outcomes, including the trained URSA models' benchmark scores, process-labeling ablations, and PS-GRPO sensitivity experiments.

M1.justification: The three-stage URSA pipeline, binary error locating, misinterpretation insertion, PRM training, and PS-GRPO procedure are unchanged. Algorithms 1–2 retain the same steps.

E1.justification: Training sources and evaluation coverage are retained, including MathVerse, MathVision, MathVista-GPS, WE-MATH, DYNAMATH, and GeoQA. The appendix's captioning, data-synthesis, and model-generalization experiments also retain their coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Table 1, the appendix comparisons, and the Best-of-N experiments. Tables 2 and 10 retain self-consistency and InternVL2.5-8B ORM as comparison methods.

E3.justification: Zero-shot evaluation, benchmark subsets and metrics, Best-of-N sampling counts, and training settings remain unchanged in Section 5.1 and Appendix F. No new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: Tables 3–4 retain the same process-labeling ablations and reward-penalty/drop-moment sensitivity tests. The appendices retain the same scaling, generalization, module-selection, data-synthesis, and failure-case analyses.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting practices are unchanged. No repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty-estimation information are added or revised.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 reports a 58.2 average for URSA-8B-PS-GRPO in both versions, and Table 2 retains the 35.1 MathVision Best-of-32 result for URSA-8B with URSA-8B-RM.

T1.justification: Equations 1–10 retain the same losses, Monte Carlo labeling definition, drop-moment and reward formulas, GRPO objectives, and Best-of-N definition. No mathematical reasoning, formal assumptions, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about the datasets, PRM verification, and PS-GRPO. The new title emphasizes process reward modeling without changing the scientific scope of these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning reward hacking, length bias, robustness limitations, and PS-GRPO's mechanism are retained. Appendix H.4 changes a reference from Section 1 to Section 4 without changing its explanation of failure patterns.

D1.justification: Appendices F–G retain the same hyperparameters, hardware, training costs, processing instructions, algorithms, and prompts. Code, data, and checkpoint access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are unchanged, including Appendix A's discussion of existing and concurrent multimodal PRM research. Its spelling edit does not alter the relationship to prior work.

P1.justification: The title changes from 'URSA: Understanding and Verifying Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Multimodal Mathematics' to 'Unlocking Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning via Process Reward Model.' Author, affiliation, correspondence, and publication text are updated. Appendix G.1 corrects 'trajectoris,' H.4 repairs a section reference, and Appendix A introduces 'ecectories' in place of 'trajectories.' The narrative structure is retained.

P2.justification: The first page is reflowed around a two-line title, revised author and affiliation block, and NeurIPS 2025 footer. Minor text-spacing and local paragraph-reflow differences occur elsewhere; figures, tables, captions, and appendix displays retain their content, organization, and placement.

improvement.justification: The revision updates front matter and makes small editorial corrections, including a useful section-reference repair, while introducing a typo in Appendix A. These limited edits leave the methods, empirical evidence, interpretations, and reproducibility information unchanged, producing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
